met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Rajasthan & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The Low Pressure Area over South West Bengal & adjoining North Odisha persisted over the same region at 1430 hrs IST of today, 08th August, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extending upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Anupgarh, Delhi, Deomali, Sidhi, Digha and centre of Low Pressure area over southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood and thence southeastwards Eastcentral Bay of Bengal and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 73°E to the north of Lat. 29°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhoodat 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
